source_snapshot.procedure: Install nvqual, run PCIe bandwidth and check GPU sensors.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes nvqual PCIe bandwidth with full log and cooling approval.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require artifact/topology, transfer shape, numeric path floors, integrity and safety evidence.

old_problem: The proprietary harness result lacked immutable artifact identity, path topology, transfer direction/size/concurrency and an approved numeric bandwidth floor, so an opaque PASS could not establish performance.
disposition_reason: The PCIe bandwidth purpose and method are explicit. ED-03 allows topology/workload values and signed floors as runtime configuration, while ED-15 ensures execution cannot PASS without the numeric oracle and ED-14 preserves the full 20-minute run.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row375 all 18 XLSX columns and history2968.
Retained every path, raw throughput sample, sensor check and subtest rather than reducing coverage to a smoke measurement.
Directly verified next formal queue row376 and no DUT command ran.

test_case.purpose: Measure every approved GPU PCIe path with the pinned NVQual workload and require its signed topology/speed/width-specific throughput floor plus clean link integrity and platform health.
required_package: Licensed NVQual provenance/version/checksum and stack compatibility
GPU UUID/BDF/bridge/root-port topology and expected speed/width
Per-path numeric floor/units/statistic/tolerance and integrity rules
Cooling/power/PSU/OOB hard stops and link recovery
test_case.test_command: After artifact, topology, drain and safety approval, capture link/error/clock/thermal/power baselines and run the pinned full PCIe-bandwidth suite once for the source 20-minute allocation; retain raw per-path samples and all subtests, compare signed floors, then verify final links/services.
test_case.expected_result: Every required path produces complete valid samples whose approved statistic meets its signed numeric floor/tolerance, all subtests/integrity checks pass, links remain at approved speed/width, and no prohibited AER, error or platform-sensor delta occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires raw path-attributed values and signed thresholds plus link/integrity/health evidence; harness PASS alone or a result without an approved numeric floor cannot pass.
safety_gate: Explicit approval for link/memory saturation and workload drain
Preserve AER/log evidence and monitor thermal/power/OOB
Abort on integrity, retrain, downgrade, disappearance or safety event; no retry
expected_evidence: Per-path statistic/floor/tolerance calculations and subtest results
test_case.recovery: Abort on link or platform anomaly, preserve evidence, use OOB to confirm host/device state, restore only approved runtime/link state, isolate a degraded path and do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Master fields consistently target PCIe bandwidth; absent project values are now explicit execution prerequisites.

blocked.reason: The method and evidence are complete; exact artifact/topology/workload/floors are safe runtime bindings.
